limitations: Different event windows, market activity, pending orders and selected scopes may confound process/latency comparisons.
CPU samples are bursts, not steady-state throughput. A completed-cycle count is not inferred from a stale status.
Receipt spans exclude pre-admission waits and include HTTP, validation, durable completion and possibly pagination.
processedAt precedes accept_batch completion. It measures observation-to-processing start, not durable commit latency.

dispatch.limitations: Undated rows excluded from time-window counts. Unacknowledged suffix attempts are censored, not proof of unknown acceptance. Attempt-to-ACK includes SDK admission, HTTP, validation and completion; it is not provider-only latency.

journal.clockLimitation: processedAt is stamped before accept_batch, not a durable completion timestamp; timestamp groups are not guaranteed batch boundaries

receipts.meaning: network-start through validation and durable completion; excludes pre-admission wait; aggregate pagination may span multiple calls
